steps.name: gemini-backend
steps.summary: Text agent on Vertex AI by default: src/lib/agent/model.ts textClientOptions()/textGenAI() (GEMINI_TEXT_BACKEND=vertex|api, GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, GEMINI_VERTEX_LOCATION=global, ADC, no key; one shared client); voice stays on the Gemini API key (ephemeral tokens). HTTP 402 logs 'gemini billing error (402)' and maps to UPSTREAM in model.ts and live.ts (voice keeps its existing message 'Voice is not available right now. Please type instead.'). Deep health (src/lib/health.ts, deps api/text/liveTokens) now returns checks store, textModel, liveModel (model lookups on the API key: Vertex models.get gives 403), textGenerate (1 token via text backend), keyGenerate (1 token on the API key; added because authTokens.create still succeeds with 402 credits, measured), liveToken. Local probe: 503 with only keyGenerate failing. eval-agent records backend; eval on Vertex 32/32 (evals/results/2026-10-13T04-56), p90 21.2 s (I-105). deploy.sh sets GEMINI_TEXT_BACKEND=vertex. Docs: ARCHITECTURE, ADR-011, SECURITY, OPERATIONS, TESTING, README; ISSUE I-104 (P0 upstream-billing, open until the AI Studio credits are topped up) and I-105. Not deployed.
